text:
alex_sales: Quick sync: Prospect AuroraBank wants BYO-KMS (HSM-backed) for their POC. Theyplan to run our keybroker connector inside their environment behind an outbound proxy. Their asks: exact egress rules, pen-test availability, and a concise POC quote for BYO-KMS.

rebecca_eng: We can run the connector as a lightweight sidecar or a managed service in their VPC. Required: outbound 443 to their KMS endpoint, client cert or mTLS from our connector to their gateway. If their proxy terminates TLS we need passthrough to preserve client certs; otherwise we cannot do mutual auth.

omar_ops: Network note: allow outbound 443 to their FQDN/IP range. If they sit an intercepting proxy in the path, it must support TCP/SSL passthrough or forward client cert info via a TLS-forwarding mode. Measured unwrap latency penalty with an intercepting proxy: median +40ms, p95 +120ms depending on RTT to HSM. If they want <50ms p95 werecommend colocated HSM gateway or dedicated routing.

lia_security: For the security questionnaire please request: HSM vendor & model, FIPS/FISMA attestation docs, whether keys are exportable or ever in plaintext outside the HSM, key rotation policy (who triggers rotation), and their custodian process. Also request a recent SOC2 type II and the artifact for HSM firmware patching.

alex_sales: Can you draft a one-page Q list I can email today? They proposed a pen-test in week of 2026-06-01. Is that okay?

lia_security: I'll draft now. Quick bullets to include: 1) Redwood never persists plaintext key material, 2) BYO-KMS requires the customer to provision a client cert and rotate it on our schedule, 3) recommended rotation coordination window is 90 minutes for live cutover, 4) request attestation before production flip.

sam_se: Pricing: BYO-KMS add-on = small integration fee + per-unwrap routing charge. For POCs we sometimes credit the integration fee if they convert to a paid pilot > $15k/mo. Also note audit log retention (90 vs 180 vs 365d) affects storage fees. Need expected unwraps/sec and retention choice to finalize numbers.

alex_sales: AuroraBank estimates: peak 120 unwraps/sec, avg ~12k/day, want logs 180d. They want a POC price + note about dedicated routing.

sam_se: Rough POC quote: integration fee waived with pilot commit; ops/routing add-on ~$2,200/mo + $0.0025 per unwrap. With sustained 120 rps peak we suggest Dedicated routing (reserved capacity) to stabilize latency — add reserved capacity line item if they want SLOs. I'll put a draft in the quote doc.

rebecca_eng: POC plan: run our connector in their VPC with VPC peering or private link. Wecan provide a load harness to emulate unwrap workload. Example test command (hey):

```
hey -c 150 -q 10 -z 60s https://staging-kms.aurorabank.internal/unwrap
```

Collect TLS client cert traces and tcpdump on the HSM gateway to verify passthrough.

omar_ops: Pen-test week of 2026-06-01 is fine from infra with a 72h scope notice. We require: authorized test IPs, test window, non-destructive testing only, and an on-call contacts list. infra-bot: created preflight checklist: https://redwood.internal/pen-test-preflight

alex_sales: Action items: 1) @lia_security create Q list and send to AuroraBank today, 2) @sam_se prepare POC quote including Dedicated routing + per-unwrap pricing and storage delta for 180d logs, 3) @rebecca_eng produce sidecar runbook + hey harness and TLS debug instructions, 4) @omar_ops prepare pen-test preflight and provide required IP list. I'll set a 30m sync for tomorrow.

infra-bot: Reminder: attestation artifact required prior to production cutover. See BYO-KMS runbook: https://redwood.internal/byo-kms-guidelines

alex_sales: Thanks everyone I'll send the questionnaire in 20m unless there are blockers. If anything urgent ping me. :thumbsup:
